timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,063.96 Cr, net profit ₹12.48 Cr.
2026-06-01: Announced opening of 5 new NEAT EVERYDAY retail stores in Ahmedabad on June 04, 2026, in addition to the existing store.
Group Mangalam launched five new NEAT Everyday retail stores in Ahmedabad on June 4, 2026.
2026-10-16: Mangalam Global Enterprise approved raising up to ₹150 Cr through the private placement of NCDs.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹982.56 Cr (+39.2% YoY), net profit ₹9.25 Cr (-48.0% YoY).

2026-10-30: Infomerics Ratings reaffirmed Mangalam Global's ₹248.45 Cr bank facilities at IVR BBB/A3+, migrating them to the Issuer Not Cooperating category and revising the long-term outlook to Negative.
